book.name: Yoan
book.title: Vaaru poia tau Yoan iboode Jon—John

content: “Saveeŋ isov tane, yau nasavia payam to ipalot gham. Leso atap ve apul ghuruuŋ ila tsiam sov.
Alooŋ. Murei, yes Yuda pale tiziir gham pa rumei toozi, ve irau yamŋa alup gham pa suŋuuŋ muul mako. Saawe tana, isaav ighe toozi eta irav tsiam eta imaat, i pale igham ŋgar ighe ibees poi pa Maaron.
Tamtamon pale tigham ŋgar tana payam pasaa, tikankaan pa Tamaŋ Maaron, ve tikankaan payau paam.

Saveeŋ tane, yau nasavia payam pataghaaŋ. Leso saawe tau pataŋani tana ivot payam, matamim iŋgal aliŋag tane, ve ayooz ariaaŋ. Yesu isavia uraat to Avuvu Patabuyaaŋ “Muuŋ, yau nasavia saveeŋ tane payam mako. Pasaa, taug nalepleep tomani gham.
Ve aazne, naghe napul gham, ve namuul nala pa Tamaŋ tau imbaaŋ ghau nalam ne. Eemon tsiam eta ighason ghau pa nugh tau naghe nala pani ne mako.
Onoon, saveeŋ tau nasavia payam ne, aat igham gham lolomim ipataŋan kat.

Eemon yau nasaav payam: Onoon kat, isaav ighe napul gham ve nala, ene pale poia payam. Pa ighe napul gham mako, ene aat Maaron Avuvu irau izilam payam mako. Ve ighe nala, ene pale nambaaŋ Palotiiŋa tawe izilam payam, leso iuul gham.
Saawe tau ilam, i aat igham tamtamon to taan tighilaal sosor toozi ve ŋgar tau iduduuŋ ila Maaron maata, ve tighilaal tighe murei pale Maaron igabiiz tamtamon ve ighur atuya pazi.
Sosor toozi, ene vene: Tighur ilam tsiau mako.
Ve saawe tau yau namuul nala to Tamaŋ, ve aghit ghau muul mako, ene aat tamtamon tighilaal tighe yau nagham ŋgar duduuŋa ila Maaron maata.

Ve uraat to gabizooŋ ve ghuruuŋ atuya pa tamtamon, ene pale ivot. Pasaa, ŋginiiŋ to yes tau titaghon taan ŋgara na, Maaron igabiiza ighe i isosor wa. Tauvene i isasaŋan mon pa saawe to Maaron ighur atuya pani.
“Yau leg saveeŋ naol to nasavia payam. Eemon irau nasavia ta aazne mako. Pale ipataŋan payam.

Eemon Maaron Avuvu, i ipaghazoŋai saveeŋ onoon to Maaron puughu. Saawe tau ilam, i pale ipaduduuŋ gham, leso aghazooŋ kat pa saveeŋ isov tau onoon na. Pasaa, i irau isavia saveeŋ eta itaghon tauu ŋgar tooni mako. Saa saveeŋ tau ilooŋa ila to Tamaŋ, tauta i pale ivotia. Ve i pale ipaghazoŋai gham pa gabua siriv tau pale ivot murei.
Saa ŋgar ma saveeŋ tau i ighamu ilam tsiau, i pale ivotia payam. Leso aghazooŋ kat payau ve aghilaal ghau aghe ezag tiina pa tapirig ve poia tsiau.
Tamaŋ ŋgar tooni ve tapiri, tomania gabua tooni naol isov, ene igheen tsiau paam. Tauta nasaav payam naghe: ‘Saa ŋgar ma saveeŋ tau Maaron Avuvu ighamu ilam tsiau, i pale ivotia payam.’”
Mbiwa to Yesu pale lolozi ipataŋan. Eemon murei pale lolozi poia muul
Yesu iseeŋ saveeŋ tooni muul ighe: “Malau mako pale ail naghog. Ve tala rig, mako aghit ghau muul.”

Tauvene mbiwa tooni siriv tivasavo zi tighe: “Wai, saveeŋ tooni tane, puughu mindai? I isaav pait ighe, malau mako pale tail naagho. Ve tala rig, mako taghita muul. Ve isaav paam ighe i pale ila to Taama.
Aliiŋa ziiri rig tau ighe: ‘malau mako’, ene puughu mindai? Iit takankaan pa saveeŋ tooni tane. I isavia saa?”

Yesu ighilaal ŋgar toozi ighe yes tighe tighasoni pa saveeŋ tooni puughu. Tauvene isaav pazi ighe: “Mindai, aliŋag ziiri tau naghe: ‘Malau mako pale ail naghog, ve tala rig, mako aghit ghau muul,’ tane ta avaghasoni gham pani ne?

Onoon kat, yau nasaav payam. Yam pale lolomim ipataŋan kat ve agham taŋiiz tiina. Ve yes tau titaghon taan ŋgara na, ene pale tintinizi. Eemon tala rig, mako lolomim ipataŋan muul mako, ve anamim tintinmim imin livaa tau ipoop. Onoon, saawe to popaaŋ, i iyamaan yavyavuuŋ tiina. Eemon saawe tau ipoop tamtamon izi, i pale loolo poia kat pa naatu paaghu tana, ve loolo iveegh pa yavyavuuŋ tau ighamu na.
“Yam tauvene paam. Aazne, lolomim ipataŋan kat. Eemon yau aat nalam naghit gham muul.
Saawe tana ighe ivot, yam pale lolomim poia le poia kat. Ve lolomim poia tana, tamtamon eta irau iwalaava payam mako.

Saawe tana ve ila, yam pale aghason ghau pa gabua eta puughu muul mako. Pasaa, ŋgar tsiam pale ighazooŋ. Onoon kat, yau nasaav payam: Isaav ighe aghason Tamaŋ pa gabua eta ila yau ezag, i aat igham payam.
Muuŋ ve ilam aazne, yam aghason Maaron pa gabua eta ila yau ezag soone. Ve yau nasaav payam: Aghasoni, o igham payam. Leso lolomim poia le poia kat.
Yesu itatan taan tapiri wa

“Saveeŋ naol tane, yau nasavia payam ila saveeŋ palelaaŋ. Eemon saawe tsiau ighe ivot, ene yau irau nasavia saveeŋ eta payam ila saveeŋ palelaaŋ muul mako. Yau aat nasaav ghazooŋa, ve napaghazoŋai gham pa Tamaŋ.
Saawe tana, yam taumim pale aghur ghasoniiŋ tsiam iŋarui Tamaŋ ila yau ezag. Lemim puughu eta to nagham avomim, ve naghur ghasoniiŋ tsiam ila pani ne mako.
Pasaa, Tamaŋ iwatagh: Yam lolomim igheen tsiau, ve aghur ilam tsiau aghe: Yau naleep tooni, ta nalam. Tauta loolo igheen tsiam, ve ighe igham poghani gham.
Onoon kat, yau naleep to Tamaŋ, ta nazilam taan. Ve aazne, saawe to napul taan, ve namuul nazala tooni, ene ilam igharau wa.”
Yesu isavia saveeŋ tane, ve mbiwa tooni tisaav pani tighe: “Tiina, aazne yo usavsaav ila saveeŋ palelaaŋ muul mako. Usaav ghazooŋa kat payei.
Tauvene yei nighilaal nighe yo uwatagh gabua naol isov. Pasaa, saawe tau tamtamon tighason ghom soone, ve yo uwatagh ghasoniiŋ toozi wa. Tauta nighur ilat tsio nighe yo uleep to Maaron, ta uzilam.”
Yesu iyol aliŋazi ighe: “Onoon? Ŋgarig gha aghur ila?

Alooŋ, saawe tsiau ilam igharau wa. Ighe ivot tane. Tauvene tamtamon pale tinaan gham le asov aparmbiriis ala lemim lemim, ve apul ghau naleep. Eemon yau zigau naleep mako. Pasaa, Tamaŋ ilepleep tomani ghau.

Saveeŋ tane, yau nasavia payam, leso apaak tuŋia ilam tsiau, ve luuma tsiau igheen tomani gham. Onoon, saawe tau aleep izi taan, pataŋani pale igham gham. Eemon aroi sov. Lolomim poia ve ayooz ariaaŋ! Pa taan tapiri, yau natatani wa.”

footnotes.text: Saawe tau Maaron ipaburigin Yesu pa mateegh, ve imuul izala pa nugh sambam, ene itotoi ghiit ighe Taama Maaron loolo poia pani, ve iyok pa uraat tooni.
Yesu aat isavia saveeŋ tane iŋarui saawe to burigiiŋ tooni.
